nodes.label: Price Tag Alt Icon
nodes.description: A 24x24 SVG icon depicting a price tag / label shape. The design shows a tag outline with a small circular hole (representing a tag eyelet) in the upper-left area and a pointed or angled right edge, rendered as a white filled path on a transparent background. The icon communicates pricing, tagging, labeling, or content categorization concepts and is used in the content management section of the UI.
